documents.title: Fictional player pause
documents.body:
# Playback
The fictional audio stream stops halfway through a song. The test trace contains the music playback interruption marker.

documents.title: Fictional library export
documents.body:
# Collection
The demo exports a local playlist inventory into a CSV file containing track titles. This is a mock library only.

documents.title: Fictional display contrast
documents.body:
# Appearance
The test display has a dark theme with white text and a high-contrast setting for readability.

documents.title: Fictional speaker pairing
documents.body:
# Hardware
The demonstration speaker connects to the mock player using Bluetooth. Observe the wireless pairing indicator.

documents.title: Fictional invoice record
documents.body:
# Test accounting
The mock receipt displays an invoice identifier and the currency of a fictitious charge. No money is collected.

documents.title: Fictional language preference
documents.body:
# Interface
The sample menu supports switching the interface from English to German for the language selector test.
